name: Diagnostic_VEC-PNT_1
questiontext:
Given that \(A\) is the point \(({{CT:0}},\,{{CT:1}},\,{{CT:2}})\) and that \(B\) is the point \(({{CT:3}},\,{{CT:4}},\,{{CT:5}})\) then the vector \(\mathbf{r}\) from \(A\) to \(B\) is [[input:ans1]] \(\mathbf{i}\) [[validation:ans1]] \(+\) [[input:ans2]] \(\mathbf{j}\) [[validation:ans2]] \(+\) [[input:ans3]] \(\mathbf{k}\).

[[validation:ans3]]
generalfeedback: Given that \(A\) is the point \(({{CT:0}},\,{{CT:1}},\,{{CT:2}})\) and that \(B\) is the point \(({{CT:3}},\,{{CT:4}},\,{{CT:5}})\) then the vector from A to B is \[\begin{array}{rcl}\displaystyle \mathbf{r}&\displaystyle =&\displaystyle \left({{CT:3}} - {{CT:0}}\right)\mathbf{i} + \left({{CT:4}} - {{CT:1}}\right) \mathbf{j} + \left({{CT:5}} - {{CT:2}}\right)\mathbf{k},\\ &\displaystyle =&\displaystyle {{CT:6}}\,\mathbf{i} + {{CT:7}}\,\mathbf{j} + {{CT:8}}\,\mathbf{k}. \end{array}\]

on_true.feedback:
This is the vector from B to A. Each component is the additive inverse of that in the vector from A to B.

Your answer is \[\left({{CT:0}} - {{CT:3}}\right)\mathbf{i} + \left({{CT:1}} - {{CT:4}}\right)\mathbf{j} + \left({{CT:2}} - {{CT:5}}\right)\mathbf{k}\mbox{.}\] The vector from A to B is \[ \mathbf{r} = \left({{CT:3}} - {{CT:0}}\right)\mathbf{i} + \left({{CT:4}} - {{CT:1}}\right) \mathbf{j} + \left({{CT:5}} - {{CT:2}}\right)\mathbf{k}\mbox{.}\]

Your answer is \[\left({{CT:0}} + {{CT:3}}\right)\mathbf{i} + \left({{CT:1}} + {{CT:4}}\right)\mathbf{j} + \left({{CT:2}} + {{CT:5}}\right)\mathbf{k}\mbox{.}\] The vector from A to B is \[ \mathbf{r} = \left({{CT:3}} - {{CT:0}}\right)\mathbf{i} + \left({{CT:4}} - {{CT:1}}\right) \mathbf{j} + \left({{CT:5}} - {{CT:2}}\right)\mathbf{k}\mbox{.}\]
Your answer is the vector from the origin to the midpoint between A and B. You may have used the wrong method.
